messages.author: 99a06696c483481a
messages.subject: SimulateData() with nonzero residual covariances
parts:
I am simulating data for the interbattery factor model, and I have found some unexpected behavior in the lavaan 0.6-9 SimulateData() function. Here is syntax for three attempts.

The first attempt (which does NOT specify residual variances explicitly but uses the standardized = T option) produces an error message (shown below).

The second attempt, which explicitly specifies residual variances and does NOT use the standardized = T option) does not produce an error message.

The third attempt (which removes the correlated residuals from the model, does NOT specify residual variances and DOES use standardized = T) also does not produce an error message.

So it looks like SimulateData() produces an error message when residual covariances are part of the model but residual variances are not explicitly specified.

ibsimmod1<-'
        f1=~0.8*y1+0.8*y2+0.8*y3+0.7*y4+0.7*y5+0.7*y6+0.6*y7+0.6*y8+0.6*y9
        y1~~0.1*y2+0.1*y3
        y2~~0.2*y3
        y4~~0.2*y5+0.2*y6
        y5~~0.1*y6
        y7~~0.2*y8+0.2*y9
        y8~~0.3*y9'

simdat<-simulateData(model=ibsimmod1,model.type="sem",std.lv=T,standardized=T,sample.nobs=500)

ibsimmod2<-'
        f1=~0.8*y1+0.8*y2+0.8*y3+0.7*y4+0.7*y5+0.7*y6+0.6*y7+0.6*y8+0.6*y9
        y1~~0.1*y2+0.1*y3
        y2~~0.2*y3
        y4~~0.2*y5+0.2*y6
        y5~~0.1*y6
        y7~~0.2*y8+0.2*y9
        y8~~0.3*y9
        y1~~0.36*y1
        y2~~0.36*y2
        y3~~0.36*y3
        y4~~0.51*y4
        y5~~0.51*y5
        y6~~0.51*y6
        y7~~0.64*y7
        y8~~0.64*y8
        y9~~0.64*y9'

simdat<-simulateData(model=ibsimmod2,model.type="sem",std.lv=T,sample.nobs=500)


testmod<-'
        f1=~0.8*y1+0.8*y2+0.8*y3+0.7*y4+0.7*y5+0.7*y6+0.6*y7+0.6*y8+0.6*y9'

testdat<-simulateData(model=testmod,model.type="sem",std.lv=T,standardized=T,sample.nobs=500)

Here is output:

> ibsimmod1<-'
+         f1=~0.8*y1+0.8*y2+0.8*y3+0.7*y4+0.7*y5+0.7*y6+0.6*y7+0.6*y8+0.6*y9
+         y1~~0.1*y2+0.1*y3
+         y2~~0.2*y3
+         y4~~0.2*y5+0.2*y6
+         y5~~0.1*y6
+         y7~~0.2*y8+0.2*y9
+         y8~~0.3*y9'
>
> simdat<-simulateData(model=ibsimmod1,model.type="sem",std.lv=T,standardized=T,sample.nobs=500)
Error in lav_start_check_cov(lavpartable = lavpartable, start = START) :
  lavaan ERROR: please provide better fixed values for (co)variances;
                variables involved are: y1 y2
>
> ibsimmod2<-'
+         f1=~0.8*y1+0.8*y2+0.8*y3+0.7*y4+0.7*y5+0.7*y6+0.6*y7+0.6*y8+0.6*y9
+         y1~~0.1*y2+0.1*y3
+         y2~~0.2*y3
+         y4~~0.2*y5+0.2*y6
+         y5~~0.1*y6
+         y7~~0.2*y8+0.2*y9
+         y8~~0.3*y9
+         y1~~0.36*y1
+         y2~~0.36*y2
+         y3~~0.36*y3
+         y4~~0.51*y4
+         y5~~0.51*y5
+         y6~~0.51*y6
+         y7~~0.64*y7
+         y8~~0.64*y8
+         y9~~0.64*y9'
>
> simdat<-simulateData(model=ibsimmod2,model.type="sem",std.lv=T,sample.nobs=500)
>
>
> testmod<-'
+         f1=~0.8*y1+0.8*y2+0.8*y3+0.7*y4+0.7*y5+0.7*y6+0.6*y7+0.6*y8+0.6*y9'
>
> testdat<-simulateData(model=testmod,model.type="sem",std.lv=T,standardized=T,sample.nobs=500)
>
